**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  [Javaagent] Return false for wrappers that already propagate context**

When a lambda wrapper created by an outer/delegating executor reaches an inner instrumented executor, this `true` sends it through `JavaExecutorInstrumentation.ExecuteRunnableAdviceScope.start` or `CallableAdviceScope.start`, which calls `attachContextToTask`; because these bootstrap wrapper types are excluded from transformation, `TaskAdviceHelper` never consumes the fallback-map state. Under the default ignored-task configuration, `canInstrumentTaskClass` already returns true for both types, so this branch skips nothing and leaves the duplicate attachment that the commit is meant to eliminate; return false here so only the wrapper's captured-field propagation runs.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L20-L24](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/fc76894f617b56c4884b1c0bf728fcb2ccf2bad1/AGENTS.md#L20-L24)
